sources.title: [2506.01844] SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs.
